title: vtc-wss: per-user events vs eventTypes/callIds
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md:255 says any non-empty VTCStreamEnable implicitly enables VTCRingEvent/VTCCallEndEvent: unclear if eventTypes excluding them still delivers rings, and :175 says callIds [] delivers no events. 'Current participant' (:173) undefined for a rung-but-unjoined callee; ignored callIds mean a subscribe-then-join client misses early events (scene-wss retains entries instead).
close_reason: Defined current participant (joinedAt non-null, leftAt null); callIds entries retained; per-user events follow eventTypes and ignore callIds.
